CustomField.label: Neutrality key
CustomField.description: AXF_CLS_IdentityFraming.key(['ITR', debitTransactionId, creditTransactionId]) for a CANDIDATE/UNILATERAL/CONFIRMED row, or key(['ITR-REVERSED', originalTransferId]) for a REVERSED compensation row. Guarantees a unique pair per leg and a single compensation per original (AXF-32, ratified 2026-09-17).
